## Projects
1. Stay Finder — Accommodation Booking Platform
   - Tech: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Tailwind CSS
   - GitHub: https://github.com/umangkhandelwall/StayFinder
   - Description: Full-stack accommodation booking platform with dynamic listings, atomic reservation transactions to prevent booking race conditions, and role-based access control.
   - Highlights: Compound B-tree indexes on booking date ranges and coordinates; responsive mobile-first UI with accessible controls.

2. Ink & Insights — AI Publishing Platform
   - Tech: Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, Google Gemini API
   - GitHub: https://github.com/umangkhandelwall/Ink-Insights
   - Description: Content publishing platform featuring automated editorial critique and Redis sliding-window rate limiting to manage AI inference quotas.
   - Highlights: Asynchronous Gemini API integration for tone and structure feedback; optimistic UI state updates.

3. GCC Intel — Market Intelligence Platform
   - Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Data Analytics
   - GitHub: https://github.com/umangkhandelwall/gccintel
   - Description: Market intelligence platform analyzing India's Global Capability Centers (GCCs), reconciling national count discrepancies, comparing operating costs across 6 metro clusters, and mapping state policy frameworks.
   - Highlights: 30 verified MNC captive records with primary source citations, 6-metro comparative cost model (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Delhi-NCR, Mumbai), and 5 state incentive frameworks.

4. LLM Powered Smart Screen Recorder
   - Tech: Python, OpenCV, Tesseract OCR, Sentence Transformers, ChromaDB, Google Gemini API
   - Description: Intelligent screen capture application that extracts on-screen text via OCR, indexes visual states into ChromaDB vector storage, and enables natural language retrieval through a Gemini RAG pipeline.
   - Highlights: Asynchronous video frame sampling with OpenCV, dense 768-dimensional vector embeddings, and exact timestamp citations.

5. Autonomous Agent Benchmarking Suite
   - Tech: Docker, Python, Bash, Linux
   - Description: Benchmark tasks and deterministic evaluation testbeds for evaluating autonomous AI coding agents on system debugging, dependencies, and repository workflows.
   - Highlights: Isolated Docker sandbox testbeds with sealed entrypoints and automated verification harnesses.
